h: Biola Adebayo puts new salon up for sale weeks after opening it
p: Actress Biola Adebayo says she is selling her newly opened salon because her sister, who was meant to run it, has been granted a Canadian visa. She said she cannot manage the business herself.
body: Nollywood actress Biola Adebayo has announced that she is putting her newly opened salon up for sale, only weeks after unveiling it.
In a video on her social media page, Biola explained that she set up the salon to give her sister, who had been going through a difficult time, a business of her own to run.
However, just days after the salon was unveiled, her sister received approval for a Canadian visa she had been waiting for for more than three years, and will now be relocating.
The actress described the visa as good news, but admitted it left her with the challenge of managing the salon herself, which led to her decision to sell it.
more: She opened the salon for her sister.
Her sister got a Canadian visa days later.
She says she cannot run it herself.
